fullPassage: With respect to health, sometimes your mind can be your own worst enemy. If you are afflicted with illness anxiety, the fear of developing a disease or already being sick, you might devote countless hours to looking up symptoms, to the point where you start to believe that you are experiencing them, even if there is nothing physically wrong with you. Such a fear may arise if you know someone who has recently been diagnosed with the illness in question and therefore are aware of exactly what to expect or if you have suffered from the condition before and worry about it returning. Going to see a doctor may seem like the wisest course of action. After all, medical professionals can provide the reassurance you need. Ironically, though, a visit to the doctor can occasionally worsen the problem. In fact, you may be so preoccupied with the notion that you are sick and that the doctor has missed something that actual physiological effects can occur such as the release of substances in the body that cause headaches. In this way, illness anxiety can become a self-fulfilling prophecy.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 worsen과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
worsen은 '악화시키다'는 뜻으로, 정반대는 '개선하다'를 뜻하는 improve
① continue(계속하다) ❌ 상태 변화 방향과 무관
② repeat(반복하다) ❌ 반대 의미가 아님
③ describe(묘사하다) ❌ 전혀 다른 의미

det.tip: worsen(악화시키다) ↔ improve(개선하다)

questions.passage: With respect to health, sometimes your mind can be your own worst enemy. If you are afflicted with illness anxiety, the fear of developing a disease or already being sick, you might devote countless hours to looking up symptoms, to the point where you start to believe that you are experiencing them, even if there is nothing physically wrong with you. Such a fear may arise if you know someone who has recently been diagnosed with the illness in question and therefore are aware of exactly what to expect or if you have suffered from the condition before and worry about it returning. Going to see a doctor may seem like the wisest course of action. After all, medical professionals can provide the reassurance you need. Ironically, though, a visit to the doctor can <u>occasionally</u> worsen the problem. In fact, you may be so preoccupied with the notion that you are sick and that the doctor has missed something that actual physiological effects can occur such as the release of substances in the body that cause headaches. In this way, illness anxiety can become a self-fulfilling prophecy.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 occasionally와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
occasionally는 '때때로, 가끔'이라는 뜻으로, 정반대는 '끊임없이, 항상'을 뜻하는 constantly
① constantly(끊임없이) ✅ 정답 — occasionally의 반의어
② rarely(드물게) ❌ 오히려 occasionally와 비슷한 낮은 빈도
③ possibly(아마도) ❌ 가능성을 나타내는 다른 축의 단어
④ briefly(잠깐) ❌ 빈도가 아니라 지속 시간을 나타냄
det.tip: occasionally(가끔) ↔ constantly(끊임없이). rarely는 오히려 비슷한 뜻이니 함정
